reviews.title: Never again until major changes happen. service is terrible
reviews.text: Flown SLM to support the country’s funds. Terrible choice. Staff doesn’t apply hospitality on board. Is very slow and lazy. Cabin Staff shows immaturity. Staff SLM head office is not helpful at all. They don’t care about customers. Majority of the staff are incapable to do their jobs.
reviews.author: Jan Z

reviews.title: Crazy Airlines
reviews.text: On the 30th of August I bought a ticket to travel from Miami to Georgetown Guyana the flight was scheduled to depart @ 1:15 pm and supposed to arrive @5:45, the flight never left Miami until 7:36 pm, I never reached Guyana until about minutes to 12 that night. They are unreliable that airline doesn’t care about their customers.. And coming back was even worse . My flight was scheduled to depart Guyana on the 13th of September for Miami @7am the flight was canceled I didn’t even no until I meet at the airport, they said they send out emails which I never received. So they said the flight was rescheduled for the 14th at 11am so we all got to the airport the flight was rescheduled again for 2pm the flight never left until 3:06 pm.. so on our way to Miami there was a storm so the flight had to divert to West Palms Beach Florida, spend like a hour on the tarmac, then we left West Palms Beach back to Miami, when we all got there we misses our connected flight, I never got home until 15th. I had to sleep at the airport just to catch a early flight out to get to Atlanta Georgia. I will never fly again with this airline they are ridiculous. I would never understand why the Guyana Government will allow this airline to fly to Guyana.. they didn’t even give us any money nothing for our inconvenience ask us if we would like to have a glass of water how crazy is that… never again i will book a flight with them..
reviews.author: Ann M

reviews.title: WORST EXPERIENCE EVER IN MY TRAVELS.
reviews.text: My Surinam flight PY421 out of Georgetown was reschedule from the 3rd to the 4th of September without any prior notice from the airline, so I missed my connecting flight out of Miami. In addition I had to stay at a hotel in Georgetown to catch my reschedule flight which was scheduled to leave on the 4th at 11:00am. The flight did not leave at 11:00am on the 4th, but left at 5:00pm which resulted in me missing my connecting flight once again in Miami. And again I had to stay at a hotel on the night of the 4th in Miami. I was finally able to get a flight out of Miami on the 5th to get home. All during this stressful time there was no assistance from the airline. I witnessed many more passengers in the same situation, even passengers with small kids, and no assistance from the airline. When I get home and finally reached out to Suriname Airline, they unapologetically said that there isn't anything they can do for me and hang up the phone. It is sad and very disappointing because I am a frequent traveler and this was the first time I had taken Surinam Airline and it would definitely be my last. In my experience of travelling, I know things will happen, but there is a right way to handle it, and this was definitely not the way especially when your business is built on and depend on the people. I do not recommend this airline to anyone.
reviews.author: Windsor@0830

reviews.title: WORST EXPERIENCE EVER
reviews.text: My flight was cancelled twice. The first one I has to pay in my hotel another night and the second cancelation was said at 11 pm. 12 hours after we were supposed to leave the airport. They changed the departurw time every 2 hours. When they saw passengers really angry they decided to take us to a hotel. When my son in Miami called them they just said there had been a mechanic problem. They charged him more money for a direct flight and the had a layover in curacao. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS AIRLINE TO ANYBODY.
reviews.author: Diana T

reviews.title: No refund on flight cancellaion
reviews.text: This airline is ridiculous. We purchased our tickets the day of, about 6 hours before the flight. When we get to the airport the attendants laughed at us and told us they weren't flying that day. Now the airline is refusing to refund the tickets. It's been 2 months since I've been trying to get the refund. Super frustrating!
reviews.author: cgreat15

reviews.title: Bad return flight
reviews.text: Terrible. They oversold the flight by about 380 tickets. And then waited forever to finally get in plane. Once on plane, I had difficulty putting my suitcase in the cabinet and asked a flight attendent for help. She told me it wasn’t her job to help me and then started saying nasty things about me in Spanish. Only after complaining and making a scene did the head flight attendant move me to first class. Just a terrible overall experience
reviews.author: Enrique F

reviews.title: Don't do it!
reviews.text: I bought a ticket in early 2019 to fly in 2020. The flight was canceled due to COVID. I still have NOT received my refund, it's 2022. I've been emailing them every couple months and they either don't respond or give me the run around. That was $700 down the drain. You can't reach them by phone unless you can call international. They finally asked me for my bank info to give me a refund. They asked for literally all info that feels more like a scam than a legit business...account number, bank name, bank address, swift code, your name, your address, currency type. Why can't they just refund back to my card? Makes no sense. But instead, asks for literally all info needed to steal money? Just don't do it. They also told me I had to wait a year for a refund and once it was a year, I realized I can't dispute this charge because it's been too long. I waited that year and emailed back and forth and now it's been 3 years. DON'T DO IT.
reviews.author: Aj

reviews.title: Unprofessional and Unequipped.
reviews.text: Couldn’t get more poor customer care. I tried multiple times to check in online, unsuccessful. I had to join the line to check in that’s fine let’s role with it. Then it took a lengthy time to check in. I had to pay for my extra check luggage - but they don’t take card payments, and they won’t charge the card on file either, and the airport’s ATMs don’t work at Concourse F or G. Supervisor staff was rude and not accommodating at all. Book your flight elsewhere so you don’t feel helpless or stranded because THEY don’t accept card payment or refuse to charge the card they have on file. Book somewhere else so you don’t then feel worse worried because of how they treat you. I won’t recommend my mom, dad or any one to travel with this airline. Work on your customer care please…
reviews.author: Keisha B

reviews.title: WORST AIRLINE EVER
reviews.text: They cancelled my tickets when I had already booked a hotel and other flights as well and it has been over a month since the cancellation and I still haven’t gotten a refund. Whenever I contact the airline they transfer me to a different department but no one seems to know how to help me out, and that is when they even answer the phone. Do not recommend .
reviews.author: Antonio C

reviews.title: No Refund for cancelled flight!
reviews.text: 2019 - I booked a flight with Surinam Airways (Trinidad - Curacao) costing US$1842.54 to travel for Easter 2020. 2020 - Trinidad's borders are closed and the trip has to be cancelled. Within two weeks I received full refunds from the hotel, tour groups and taxis - with the exception of Surinam Airways. Surinam Airways' option for a full refund was I had to wait 12 months - so I opted to wait. Fast forward 1 year later - 2021. I check my account - NO refund, NO contact from the airline. I send an email to Surinam Airways where some personal information is requested and I comply. September 2021 - After numerous emails with their claims agent, contact with the local Trinidad Agent and the face book team, I am still awaiting my refund and no closer to getting it. The claims agent excuse - The refund department is handling it. The local agent took my call, requested an email and never responded. The face book team told me the refund department is handling it. Week after week I have only received excuses and excuses but NO REFUND! So if you are booking with this airline please know that this can happen to you if your flight is cancelled. This is the first class treatment you can expect from Surinam Airways!
reviews.author: Princesssenorita

reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: I bought a ticket to mia for 2 people the upcoming day before the flight the cancel the flight had very good airline been booking flight with them for a long time and this time I just said to that it’s overwhelming they told me I have to wait 2 months for a refund and I ask if I can get onto another flight they told me they will transfer the 2 people to American Airlines goes on to find out that the flight was on a reservation and they never paid for the flight.
reviews.author: Rajen Roy1

reviews.title: Better than expected!
reviews.text: I’ve flown on some hideous local airlines and was expecting not much less with Surinam Airways, however their plane that I flew on was clean, on time/early, cabin crew were pleasant and they offered a light snack and a drink. Okay so you’re never going to get 5 stars but they are trying and I love their new branding “93% Forest, 100% Surinamese” - brilliant. Get there early as they will leave without you! Also expect a long wait in arrivals as immigration took me almost 3 hours, more than double my actual flying time. You have been warned :)
reviews.author: Matt

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: For my flight to miami i had choose the suriname airways to travel with first timer witht his airways company. Have to say that it was nice not to much waiting to board the flight self was good smooth meals onboard was delicious tipical suriname meal and some other assortment meals. Furder no complain. Good job suriname airways
reviews.author: Jermainearuba

reviews.title: Dysfunctional Website & Incompetent Staff
reviews.text: On 9/30/19 I booked flights between Port of Spain and Paramaribo directly on Surinam Air official site. Departing flight was on 12/29/19 from Trinidad at 4:15 p.m. arriving in Suriname at 6:45 p.m. Returning flight was scheduled for 1/1/20 at 6 p.m. and landing in Port of Spain at 6:30 p.m. We chose this airline because those times were perfect for our schedule in Paramaribo around the pre-celebrations and events of Owru Wari. On 12/28, attempted to check-in online but site said pre check-in was not available. Got to airport next day two hours before 4:15 p.m. flight, there was no kiosk or employees around for check in. Finally found an employee to find flight was scheduled for 2:45 p.m. and already on the runway. Employee stated they didn't understand how I was able to book the times my reservation showed. Even our return flight was incorrect, as that flight time was 9:30 a.m. instead of the 6 p.m. on our itinerary. Surinam Air didn’t have another flight to Paramaribo until two days later, so we booked our own flight out through Caribbean Air, whose earliest flight was next day at 9:30 p.m. Our hotel, Ramada Princess, was pre-paid for which is standard during Owru Wari. We lost out on nearly two days combined of our trip due to Surinam Air’s website error. To add, Surinam Air employees in Port of Spain and call center ensured us our return flight was confirmed and not cancelled due to missing the initial flight. Of course, when departing Paramaribo on 1/1/20, we checked in to find our reservation had been cancelled as a no-show. We waited nearly an hour and a ½ for supervisor to reconfirm us on the departure. I have requested reimbursement from Surinam Air for at least cost of initial flight – OR - cost of Caribbean Air flight we booked ourselves. This does not include the nearly two days combined we lost in advance hotel payment and time lost to explore Paramaribo. Several times I’ve provided the original itinerary, the corrected itinerary, the Caribbean Air receipt and the Ramada Princess hotel receipts. I have given them more than 30 days to respond, and all I keep receiving is request has been forwarded to the claims department. The only reason I'm giving 2 star poor instead of 1 star terrible, the redeeming factor was they put us up in a hotel during the time we had to wait for Caribbean Air flight. Definitely want to visit Paramaribo again, but it will not be on Surinam Air.
reviews.author: Kirreck

reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.text: I flown with Surinam Airways 6 time and of those 6 times I had reached only once on time in Miami. 5 times I had a delay for more then 10 hours. We where suppose to depart at 11 am instead we left around 9 pm. If it happens once ok, but 5 times?!!!! I lost a connection flight and had to stay over one night in MIA. The airline didn't accept their responsability in this matter. After claiming the hotel bill, it took almost a year to get a refund of 110$. I won't recommend this airline. I rather pay a little more with another airline, but at least I reach in time.
reviews.author: Brian Aruba

reviews.title: Terrible Experience Lost my luggage
reviews.text: We lost our luggage flying from Miami to Aruba. We called many many times and nobody answered the phones. I emailed the listed email and have not heard from them. Terrible experience I do not want to have again.
reviews.author: Maria R

reviews.title: 3 Strikes = You Are OUT!
reviews.text: Arrived in MIA airport hotel from California to find out my flight from MIA to Guyana was cancelled until the following day. I had to buy a whole new ticket on American Airlines for $330.00 more in order to get there the day I planned. Went from hotel to Georgetown, Guyana, airport 3 hours before flight to Paramaribo. Arrived at airport to be told the flight would be 7.5 hours late. I got to stay awake all night long sitting in a hard chair...not easy on a 69 year old back! Strike 3 - You Are Out! This is the worst thing Suriname Air did to me. After arriving 7.5 hours late to Paramaribo, I was designated as a transfer passenger. I begged them to make sure my suitcase would be put on the plane to POS. I pointed it out by the carousel and they said it would be placed on-board. Guess what happened???? I just picked up my suitcase 11 days later in my home city of San Jose, California. I had to deal with NO clothes, NO hairbrush/make-up, NO asthma inhalers, No bathing suit/snorkel, No expensive outfit for my niece's wedding in Florida, plus many other items. We will see how much compensation I receive???!!! Thank you Suriname Airways for making my trip a living HELL!!!!!
reviews.author: alicerabbit

reviews.title: Positive expectation
reviews.text: Good flight, WONDERFUL CABIN ATTENDANTS, Tasty food, enough drinks and a better airplane. Smooth landing in Miami
reviews.author: John G

reviews.title: Nice flight and on time
reviews.text: We flew to paramaribo with a group of 30 pax flight was without delays, friendly staff. Going the bread was a bit stale. But when flying back the food was excellent! ! Really liked the chicken sandwich. A pleasant experience. Thanks!
reviews.author: Mightymike1966

reviews.title: ok flight
reviews.text: a four hour flight. front seatings not that comfy. the staff was good and polite. flight back we had a 9 hour delay and got a voucher of just $15 per person. that was awfull.
reviews.author: Allen

reviews.title: The plane flew three hours ago without notifying the schedule change
reviews.text: I arrived at the airport two and a half hours before takeoff. However, the plane was already taking off and I was told that it was already too late. The airport counter said that the next same plane was two days later. I had to buy another airline's plane for $ 536. Mr.*** Suriname Airlines said it was a refund of only $ 50 at Claim. I was convinced once, but I still can't agree with that, and I still send an email requesting a $ 536 refund. However, his email no longer comes. (Next time I will introduce an email with him) 離陸2時間半前に空港に着きました。 しかし、飛行機はすでに飛び立っていて、私は「もう遅いよ」といわれた。 空港カウンターは次の同じ飛行機は二日後だといわれた。 しかたなく他の航空会社の飛行機を５36ドルで買わなければならなかった。 スリナム航空はクレイムでは50ドルだけの返金と言った。 一度は納得した私だったが、やはりそのことに納得ができず、現在も536ドルの返金をお願いするメールを出している。 しかし彼からのメールは来なくなった。 (次回、彼とのEメールを紹介します)
reviews.author: SKIPSKIP

reviews.title: Suriname Airways
reviews.text: The flight was on-time and very comfortable. The staff was friendly and even though the flight was short, the airline served sandwiches (cheese and chicken) and refreshments.
reviews.author: shosein

reviews.title: An ok flight
reviews.text: It was not the worst flight I've ever had, and a plus was the friendly staff and ok food (is airplane food ever good?). But SLM uses outdated aircrafts. It felt I was back in the 90s. Space between rows was very limited. When the seat in front of me leaned backwards, there was no room for my legs anymore, and I'm 1.60m tall (or short). Also, the there's no inflight entertainment. No screens, with the exception the main screens on the ceilings and main walls. It's a 8.5hrs flight and you can survive without a tv for that time. But these days, you would assume that all long flights have an entertainment system. Again, it can be worse, but be prepared when boarding SLM.
reviews.author: askok

reviews.title: Unfriendly staff
reviews.text: the airline did NOT notify us about Aruba yellow fever card and we was denied boarding and they we're very rude and unprofessional.
reviews.author: chris s

reviews.title: Excellent Flight !!
reviews.text: The flight was extremely excellent and smooth. The on board crew member and check in agents at MIA greated with a smile and with great service. Good air fee !! Will definetly fly with Surinam Airways again !!
reviews.author: Zuhaila H

reviews.title: Great service on board Surinam Airlines
reviews.text: Very friendly and professional staff. The plane was clean and in excellent condition. I was surprised that a light meal was served on this very short flight.
reviews.author: Ravesh L

reviews.title: This particular flight was very good
reviews.text: Surinam Airways flights are a joy when they actually fly. Flight attendants are attentive and friendly and they always serve some kind of food, albeit small. I arrived at the check-in counter 2 minutes before it closes for check-in, but they did take me and bag was sent properly. Hence no complaints. Only praises ABOUT THIS PARTICULAR FLIGHT. I emphasize this point as Surinam Airways has a habit of delaying or cancelling altogether their flights. When this happens we have nothing we can do, as they do not have alliance with any other airline. So it's all about taking a risk - a fairly big one for that matter.
reviews.author: runner750

reviews.title: Very accommodating from beginning to end
reviews.text: Jared and Jerome at the Port of Spain office were very accommodating to my group of 14. We were able to secure seats months in advance with just a very small down payment. Jared accommodated us with the constant changes and missed deadlines right down to the week before our travel dates. I was so grateful because so many things popped up for our group causing trouble. The flight left earlier than planned since all passengers were checked in. We arrived in Curacao 35 minutes before scheduled. Again on out return flight, we arrived in Port of Spain earlier than anticipated. We received eats and a drinks on that short flight on both routes which was shocking as it's been a while I've received such service on short flights. It seemed to have been discontinued on other carriers. My family and I are not picky people and did enjoy. The flight itself was the smoothest our group have experienced in a small aircraft. I didn't know we were going to land until the plane itself landed on June 23rd, 2019. Flight PY730 CUR to POS. Keep up the great work guys until our next trip with you.
reviews.author: V-Yeates

reviews.title: First and last time
reviews.text: This was our first and last time with Surinam Airways. It's that I did not have any other choice from Aruba to Surinam. I had booked our flight 5 months in advance. Apparently they had a schedule change where we never were informed about. 2 days before departure I checked Aruba Airport website to check our flight. According to their website, no flight at all. Called with our agency in the Netherlands and after that with SLM Aruba. First they did not want to agree with paying for our hotel, but at the end they did. But it took them 2 days!!! On the day of departure I had to hear from the reception that our room was extended. Not even a phone call from the airline itself. Good customer service, NOT! We are already returned from our holiday 3 months ago and they still have not replied on the claim I have submitted with the them. Already send reminders 2 times, next thing that I will be doing is calling them. Besides the BAD customer service their ground staff is not better. They act like they own the airline. Their aircrafts, too old... When was their last check? I will never ever by flying with them again. From Amsterdam the same crap. Always delayed. It's not that KLM is never delayed, but at least they answer my emails and calls. That is why I don't mind paying a bit more. It's a miracle that SLM is not yet bankrupt.
reviews.author: AshMo

reviews.title: Small airline, decent service
reviews.text: Suriname Airways uses an 737-700 on the POS to Curaçao route. An older aircraft but the interior is updated with leather seats throughout. What surprised me was that they served a snack on the 1.5 hour flight and it what one could consider a Caribbean version of "comfort" food - bread and cheese. All points of the service engagement were favourable and I would definitely use them again notwithstanding some new competition on the route.
reviews.author: k f

reviews.title: do not recommend
reviews.text: - early 2018 I buy a ticket Cayenne / Paramaribo / Curacao - mid 2018 Surinam Airways decides for "commercial reasons" to stop the Cayenne / Paramaribo route - the Customer Service informs me by email that the refund of the unprocessed flight (Cayenne / Paramaribo) will be done after the flight Paramaribo / Curaçao. Since this time the Customer Service is no longer answering to my emails. ... and, on top of, a letter to the President of Surinam Airways is still unanswered ....
reviews.author: pinpin9

reviews.title: Going Home
reviews.text: Good service by the flight att with Mrs Homoed als purser Averidge meal To give you Just the taste What you get when you are in Suriname Good flight by one if the first female pilots of Suriname, Mrs Deira
reviews.author: Cathrin Jüdell

reviews.title: A comfortable travel experience
reviews.text: The flight was on time, The cabin crew i.e. stewardesses were pleasant as well as attractive. It was overall a pleasant experience.
reviews.author: Garth Wybran Thomas

reviews.title: No problem flight
reviews.text: From checkin it was smooth no problrm ,on time both ways rir hostess were lovely and helpful baggage were on time
reviews.author: naresh3251

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: This trip was well executed: check-in started on time, we even left 5 minutes earlier. In the end, arrived 30 minutes ahead of the estimated arrival time. The pilot was very skilled and the crew delivered excellent service. All in all: a very pleasant trip.
reviews.author: 797whitneyc

reviews.title: Not bad
reviews.text: This was a decent flight. The flight attendants were courteous and helpful. The general atmosphere was okay.
reviews.author: Kim S

reviews.title: Short flights to Curacao
reviews.text: From Suriname, we flew first 1hour and 15 minutes to Port of Spain / Trinidad. After 40 minutes ground time ( passengers were disembarking and embarking ) , we flew to our final destination which was Curacao. The second leg was also around 1 hour and 15 minutes. Due to the short trips we were offered a sandwich and a drink on both stretches.
reviews.author: exoticfauna

reviews.title: Just an average airline
reviews.text: This is a long flight to suriname; first stops at georgetown, then quick flight to suriname; i have flown first class and economy. business class is where you get best service, wine, beer is a plus especially because of long flight; I have first class with them 4 times with no issues. When you fly economy they tell you there is no alcohol. I don't have a problem with that but don't lie because i know first hand there is alcohol. In economy they told me they have no alcohol. In business they do give alcohol. Flight attendants could be friendlier.
reviews.author: vaioman

reviews.title: Only a fleet of 3 planes
reviews.text: Only 3 planes on the fleet , they try the old fashion way , wish they use les plastic on board , its nice to get some food on board , how ever every thing is wrapt in plastic , the flight and the plane t self is bit 1990...
reviews.author: Juan Oehninger

reviews.title: Improvement in service on Suriname Airways
reviews.text: As a regular passenger on Suriname Airways since 2016 I am pleased to report that the food served on board has improved this year and that the 737s are not MAX and better than the ageing ones used on the route in years past. The staff on board and on the ground both in Miami and Georgetown are courteous and efficient. The schedule is a lot friendlier than American Airlines and the fares dont jump too much, unlike the giant new comer American Airlines!
reviews.author: Roland d

reviews.title: Totally onorganized Airline
reviews.text: Received a call that two days before my departure that my flight would be 9 hours late departing on Thursday Dec 13th, I left Miami December 14th AT 1 AM. The airline offered Subway vouchers for food. For my return flight on January 4th as i was confirming that my flight was leaving on time, i was told that my flight was changed to saturday then it was again changed to Tuesday January 8th. if i did not call the airline, i would not have known that my return flight was shanged. Very bad service for an airline.
reviews.author: Supersand69

reviews.title: Suriname Airways, March 1, 2019, excellent performance
reviews.text: The airline arrived on time as scheduled on Miami International Airport. Check in procedures at the Surinam Airways counter were smooth and the staff was very friendly. The counter also opened as scheduled. Although there was some intermission due to logistics the staff still managed to let the passengers board the airplane on time. The flight crew greeted the boarding passengers warmly. As a passenger you immediately feel at ease by such a warm welcome. During the flight the cabine crew treated their passengers very well and with a smile. The service was excellent. No complaints whatsoever. Couldn’t be better. The interaction with the passengers was wonderful. Soon after the airplane departed from Miami International Airport, the passengers were served a meal and beverages. The meal box contained yellow rice and chicken meat. And as desert a chocolate cookie was added. If you prefer to, you also have a piece of bread. The food was excellent and well prepared. As a matter of fact, Surinam Airways is well known for its delicious meals throughout the years. It was not different this time. After 2 hours and 45 minutes the airplane landed at Reina Beatrix International Airport in Aruba to pick up passengers. The toilets were cleaned thoroughly during this stop. After 45 minutes the airplane departed and headed to Johan Adolf Pengel International Airport in Suriname. The Boeing 700-737 landed as scheduled, again on time. In short, Flight PY 462 on March 1, 2019 was a smooth flight from the departure point up to the final destination, all according to schedule. Compliments to an excellent crew, both in the cockpit and in the cabine. Chapeau, Surinam Airways!
reviews.author: henri t

reviews.title: excellent on time performance, great service
reviews.text: The flight was performed on time with a pleasant crew as always when one flies PY. The crew is very attentive and friendly, very professional. The flight was performed on time, in fact a few minutes early and arrived ahead of schedule. The same goes for the return flight. SLM YOU ROCK!
reviews.author: MARLY47

reviews.title: Retarted idiots
reviews.text: It seems to be an everyday Thing that the airline moves flight to an earlier time, without telling anybody and then claim we had no contact number. They are just lying cheaters who try to mess with people on DAILY bases! My lawyer is already on the hunt.
reviews.author: StephanLu

reviews.title: I like flying SLM
reviews.text: I have been flying to Miami with SLM for the last 8 years. The service is great and they are one of the few airlines left that still offer a hot meal that is already included in your ticket price. The only thing I can mention is that in the flights from Aruba to Miami there is no in flight entertainment (no biggie, I always have my tablet or laptop handy with enough entertainment for the entire flight). I would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Arnold S

reviews.title: Worst airline experience in my life
reviews.text: Absolute worst experience. The flight was delayed over 15 hours, there is no 24 hour line to call, just got an answering machine. Updates on flight status were almost non-existent, and there is nothing to do at the Paramaribo airport. Staff was highly disorganized. I had booked a continuing flight with six hours to spare, figuring that was plenty of time. The delay cost me $440 to re-book my continuing flight, and the claims department has been non-responsive. This airline is unacceptable as a national airline in any part of the world and if there is any other flight option I advise avoiding Suriname Airways.
reviews.author: Weston R

reviews.title: Always a pleasure to fly with SLM
reviews.text: I think I have been mostly on flights from Surinam Airways to travel abroad. Thus far I have little to no complaints personally. Maybe I am just lucky... and I like to keep it that way.
reviews.author: claytonderby

reviews.title: First flight in 28 years...
reviews.text: The flight was good, short trip about an hour and a half, no meals provided due to length of trip, we were fine with that. not much leg room though. Smooth journey.
reviews.author: Juliana H

reviews.title: Very nice staff, nice food but not always on time
reviews.text: SLM has super nice serving staff, good pilots and nice food. The only thing they are very often delayed and do not inform the passengers most of the time.
reviews.author: pancho169

reviews.title: O.K airlines, crew a bit noisy, but nice lounge in Paramaribo Airport.
reviews.text: O.K airlines, crew a bit noisy, but nice lounge in Paramaribo Airport. It was a short flight, but took another flight with them, all were o.k
reviews.author: Shlomi T
